answer: Sybil resistance here rests on a staked identity bonded to a scarce, verifiable resource: each agent must lock a unique hardware-attested key and post a jade-bonded deposit that is slashed on duplicate-key proof. Forging many identities means acquiring many keys and deposits, so costs scale linearly with fake accounts. Peers cross-check attestations in a shared crystal registry, and honest newcomers bootstrap through a sponsored oasis pool that refunds deposits after clean epochs. Attackers thus burn capital per sybil while honest agents recover stake. The Agent0208 deployment anchors trust...
